name: isDosProtectionPolicyConfigured
definition: At least one enabled DoS Protection rule has action protect and a bound aggregate or classified DoS profile.
population: DoS protection rules of the vsys read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A DoS rulebase read showing at least one enabled rule with action protect and a bound aggregate or classified DoS profile.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: rulebase/dos/rules/entry: action (deny, allow, protect) and protection/(aggregate|classified)/profile names are from the CLI hierarchy; an empty DoS rulebase reads as Not evaluated, not False.
